independent_review.reviewer: independent batch-5 cold reviewer, distinct from the lane author and the coordinator
independent_review.scope: The reviewer re-fetched each cited source into its own scratch and looked at the pages as images, comparing hashes with the lane's acquisitions. It covered all four new documented stages: Altés 2011 pp. 5 and 12; Altés 2007 pp. 7-8, 16-17 and 40; Pallarés 2015 pp. 349-351 and 360 with the reproduced title page; the BnF UNIMARC record; USUARIUM 59, 588 and 7002; and Prague 33 B 22 IMG 4, 9, 11, 16, 290 and 444 plus all twelve calendar months. Both loci of the Veronica transition were re-opened (Vatican Inc. III.420 ff. 35r and 36r; Prague IMG 290). The reviewer also checked the 2026 pre-press PDF and the 1981 pages behind the three added second-recension units, the Roman 1970, 1981 and 1954 preface comparison, Notitiae 1976 p. 432 and 1978 p. 69, the four Mozarabic Notitiae issues (1991 p. 671; 1992 pp. 365, 396, 404; 1993 pp. 688, 726; 1994 p. 544), the Aquileia 1494 Canon (hash-verified copy), the Paléographie musicale XX introduction, Ceriani 1884 pp. 2-3, the WLB and Handschriftenportal records, Delmoro p. 73 (text layer), the BSB 1712 manifest and title, and the Zaguán and USTC Zaragoza records. Mechanics checked: the row-level dossier diff (no text fields changed; only the declared Mozarabic stage), ownership, the audit route rows and the 126/3/45 counts, and hygiene. Corrections: three propers units resting on the unverified 2026 PDF moved from ambrosian-second-recension to gap ambrosian-gap-second; the 1993 p. 726 'hispanica' notices are no longer called Spanish deferred translations; the 1609 letter's undated reference to Gaspar's edition is no longer equated with 1594; two Ravenna gap dispositions changed from narrowed to unchanged-searched; the 1609 candidate's relation to amiet-usuarium-6042 is qualified; and minor wording was fixed (Zaragoza, Tarragona distinctness, Ambrosian first-reform next source, PM XX library). Not checked: original leaves of Tarragona 1499 and Urgell 1509/1535-1536 (BVPB refused with HTTP 429 at 14:00:01Z; no digitization otherwise); the H-1-152 foliation images (the holding record was used instead); the Roderic shelfmark range (HTTP 503); the ISTC/IBE identifiers (CERL challenge); the Valencia, Aquileia 1517 and Messina colophons beyond batch-4 cold confirmation; and the lane's negative searches, which were not re-probed. No new stages, transitions or candidates were added by the review.

limits: Page-level inspection only. Every new or changed documented stage and transition rests on loci the parent viewed as images (including re-viewing all loci reported by the two read-only research forks); Tarragona 1499 and Urgell 1509/1536 stages rest on scholarly descriptions, a transcribed contract, a reproduced title page and catalogue transcriptions, not on directly inspected original leaves. No body-text collation; text coverage unchanged; no text field of any Hispano-Mozarabic stage was touched. Hosts refusing or failing: BVPB (429), Gallica (403), HathiTrust (403), CCPB (403), BNE (403), PEM (403), Google Books (429 quota), IRHT and WLB digital (timeouts), Internet Culturale (CAPTCHA/TLS), manoscrittidatati.it (expired TLS certificate, not bypassed); these are access limits, not negative findings. Acquired bytes stay in scratch with no redistribution basis assessed. Research forks (Italian, Ambrosian) worked read-only in exclusive scratch subfolders; the parent made all tracked edits.
